verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents SSH-based access to instances (key-based login, running commands, transferring files) and one-click template launches for pre-built environments, which developers could use to attach VS Code Remote-SSH or run Jupyter if the template includes it. However, there's no explicit documentation of a native 'open Jupyter' button or step-by-step VS Code/Cursor one-click connect workflow. Missing for 10: explicit Jupyter notebook access instructions, explicit VS Code/Cursor remote-connect guide, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of a true one-step IDE/Jupyter connection.
